text:
sarah-support: customer reported embeddings shape changed after we rolled a pinned model variant. they pinned 'fast-embed-gecko' to keep latency but now vectors are 1536 -> 1024, causing upsert failures in their index.
jenna-cs: ugh, which customer? any request ids? :facepalm:
sarah-support: ACME Corp. request id: r-0a1b2c3d, sample payload and response: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"fast-embed-gecko","input":"hello world"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer x'` -> response `{"data": [{"embedding": [..1024 floats..]}], "model":"fast-embed-gecko"}`
alex-eng: pinging the release notes — we rolled an internal variant optimization yesterday that swaps to a quantized variant when pinned for latency. maybe the quantized variant outputs a different vector size because it's a distilled head.
mike-ml: that sounds like the model change not just quantization. which model family is fast-embed-gecko pinned to? distill vs base mismatch explains dimension reduce. can you paste the model metadata from the API `model_info` endpoint?
sarah-support: customer attached model_info: `{"name":"fast-embed-gecko","variant":"v2.0-pin","vector_dim":1024,"commit":"abc123"}` they said previously vector_dim was 1536.
alex-eng: ok timeline: yesterday 03:12 UTC we pushed a canary that updated mapping for fast-embed-gecko to point at commit abc123 (a distilled variant) for pinned requests to hit lower latency. seems the pin respected but we did not surface vector_dim change in the compatibility checks.
jenna-cs: customer says their index ingestion started failing with schema mismatch errors: `Vector length mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024`. They do bulk upserts and the pipeline broke.
mike-ml: immediate mitigation: 1) roll the pin back to prior commit (pre-distill) or 2) provide customer a temporary rewriter that pads/truncates embeddings (not ideal), 3) reindex to accept 1024 dims. I'll prepare a rollback if we approve.
alex-eng: can we confirm which customers are pinned to fast-embed-gecko? I can run a query: `SELECT count(*) FROM pins WHERE model='fast-embed-gecko' AND env='prod'`. If low, rollback is safer.
sarah-support: customer asked for ETA to resolution, they're blocking a release. can we give 2-4 hours?
mike-ml: I'll take ownership. rolling back the pin now will take ~30-45m to propagate. will run compatibility check script after rollback: `python tools/check_embed_dims.py --model fast-embed-gecko --expected 1536`.
jenna-cs: thx. can we also add a guard so pinned model variant changes that alter vector_dim generate an alert and require manual approval? this would prevent silent dimension shifts.
alex-eng: agreed — creating a follow-up ticket to add a preflight check and a UI warning for pinning variants with vector_dim changes. linking to incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-8492
sarah-support: updated customer: "we're prioritizing this; temporary rollback expected in ~45m, will confirm when ingestion is green." :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: rollback job started for pin fast-embed-gecko -> target commit def456 by @mike-ml at 1950001260
mike-ml: rollback completed, running smoke tests now.
jenna-cs: customer confirms ingestion resumed and errors cleared. they asked for root cause and steps we took.
sarah-support: forwarding explanation and ETA for preventative fix (preflight + alert). assigned to ENG-8492. customer happy for now, asking for postmortem.
alex-eng: adding postmortem items: (1) surface vector_dim in model catalog UI, (2) preflight checks on pin changes, (3) automated regression test for embedding dim when changing model pointers, (4) customer notification when pinned model's vector dim would change.
mike-ml: filing postmortem and assigning owners. closing thread once docs and PRs are opened. :white_check_mark:
